name: Zaa Zaa.
source:
Zaaー. Zaaー.

The TV screen was nothing but static.

And on it, suddenly, a boy appeared.

Plunged into despair, over and over.

Experiencing sorrow countless times. 

This pain in my heart will never fade. 

No matter what. 

Even so, I want to live.

Source: https://boys.ahito.com/contents/game/big/zaza/
translation:
扎啊。扎啊。

电视屏幕上什么也没有，只有静态。

突然，上面出现了一个男孩。

一次又一次陷入绝望。

经历过无数次的悲伤。

这种痛在我心里永远不会消失。

无论。

即便如此，我也想活下去。

来源：https://boys.ahito.com/contents/game/big/zaza/
